redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_stamp_verification.py --selftest --stage sr-red-baseline` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 1 of 17 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (named by --case, HEAD's own tests green on HEAD's code), each passing with the working tree's implementation - ns1 (house FAIL): SELFTEST FAILED: 16/17 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home)

outcome.technical: stamp-verification.py: new section 'a stage the task's own test files add' - UNKNOWN_STAGE prefix, unknown_stage_labels() (parses the harness's unknown-stage FAIL label back to its labels; None for any other label or one with a detail appended), new_stages(cmd, head_texts, wt_texts) (the --stage labels the command names that are a string literal of a declared test file's working-tree copy and of none of HEAD's copies; none when HEAD is unreadable or a HEAD copy does not parse), new_stage_baseline(head, cmd, stages) (HEAD's house run failed ONLY unknown-stage cases, every failing case one of them and the tally's failed count equal, labels all new). baseline_problem() takes stages and reads that baseline as green; red_verdict()'s proved basis then says 'failing only the unknown-stage check for `zz`, which the task's test files add - the stage is new at HEAD'; run_red() computes stages from HEAD's blobs (_cat_blobs) and the working tree, passes them to the fix-run decision and the verdict, and the payload's baseline carries newStages. _harness.py: could_not_run(check, label, reason) (a FAILING case labelled 'COULD NOT RUN HERE - reason', id kept), UNKNOWN_STAGE + unknown_stage_label(); staged_selftest uses it; selftest cases bk9, bk10. test_stamp_verification.py: sr23 moved out of sr-process into a new stage sr-sigterm: the nested red's command writes its pid to a mark (atomic rename), the case polls against START_DEADLINE instead of a fixed window, a mark never seen is _harness.could_not_run, the removal assertion (_removal_holds) is unchanged. A SECOND cause of sr23 red inside the helper's throwaway was found and fixed: the old leftover filter was a substring test of every worktree line for the throwaway prefix, so the fixture repo itself - built under a TMPDIR that lies inside a throwaway holder - read as a throwaway left behind (observed: running the working-tree helper with --stage sr-sigterm before this fix, sr23 FAILed with left=[the fixture root]); _throwaways_of() now lists only trees whose holder carries the prefix, never root. New cases: sr23b (command reaches its mark only after a delay past the old window - red with the old 10 s window emulated, started=False; green with the deadline), sr23c (SIGKILL strands a throwaway and _removal_holds is False; leftover worktree and holder removed), sr23d (repo inside a throwaway-named dir is not a leftover, a registered one beside it is); ns1-ns4 in _new_stage_cases (called from sr-red-baseline): ns1 new stage zz red-then-green PROVES with the basis naming `zz` new at HEAD (red on HEAD's helper: could-not-prove 'already red'), ns2 HEAD already holding a red zz stays already-red, ns3 new zz beside a stage red at HEAD stays already-red, ns4 a typo label new in neither copy stays already-red; nu1-nu3 in new stage sr-new-stage-units (label parse round-trip, this suite's own unknown-stage output parsed by the helper, new_stages units). Reds watched first: ns1 FAIL exit=3 could-not-prove on the unfixed helper; sr-new-stage-units raised AttributeError (unknown_stage_labels absent); sr23b FAIL with START_DEADLINE=10 (the old window). Red-first command chosen: `--stage sr-red-baseline`, an EXISTING stage, because submit runs the driver checkout's stamp-verification.py, which does not have the new-stage reading - a new label would be graded already-red there; dry run of the driver's helper on that command: proved, ns1 the task's own. In-throwaway check: working-tree helper `red ... -- python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_stamp_verification.py --selftest --stage sr-sigterm` -> baseline read as a new stage (green), task run ALL PASS 4/4, i.e. sr23 green inside the helper's throwaway (the helper then answers 'passed, proves nothing', as expected for a test-side fix). Gates by exit code: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py exit 0 (331/331 files ok); python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --spaced exit 0; ruff check plugins/audit tools exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- --no-tips --violations plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/hooks plugins/audit/tests exit 0; own command exit 0 (ALL PASS 17/17). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md not edited: no file added, and the module-map fence contains `_deps.py --render`'s output verbatim (checked by substring, True).
outcome.descriptive: sr23 now waits honestly and no longer mistakes its own fixture for a stranded throwaway, so the suite is green inside a red-first throwaway; and a task whose new cases sit in a new --stage can now have its red proved.
